mission.description: The drone leaves its base at (4730, 21591) and has to end up at (14151, 5444). On the way it must stop at A (Childrens Hospital Oakland Alternate Heliport) at (-4046, 19073), B (Police Pistol Range Heliport) at (-21922, 7717), C (UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay Helipad) at (-12357, 12967), D (Half Moon Bay Airport) at (-22098, -15189); visit A before B; visit B before C; visit C before D. Keep it no lower than 40 m and no higher than 80 m. The restricted areas and obstacles (Z1 [Oakland San Francisco Bay Airport (KOAK, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z2 [San Francisco International Airport (KSFO, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z3 [San Carlos Airport (KSQL, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z4 [Palo Alto Airport (KPAO, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m]) are off limits, and that includes cutting across a corner of one on the way between two stops. The whole trip may not be longer than 122628 meters. The battery only allows 128514 energy units, where energy = route length + 30 x total climb (so low altitudes save battery). (START is Skyline Helipad; DEST is Sutter Medical Center Castro Valley Heliport.) Coordinates are meters east/north of the region center.
